mentions.name: MyBulkCards
mentions.description: A phone app and website for scanning, organizing, and searching Pokémon card collections, especially thousands of bulk cards. Users organize cards into boxes, search their own and friends' inventories, and track trades to make deck building easier. It includes computer vision models trained to detect and identify Pokémon cards that run entirely on the phone. The Android app is built with React Native and in public testing, with an iPhone version planned.
mentions.problem: With thousands of bulk cards in storage, it is hard to know exactly what you own and where it is stored, making deck building and finding cards a matter of digging through boxes of cards.
mentions.audience: Pokémon card players and collectors; the Android app is in public testing with people from the author's local Pokémon league
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been continuing work on https://mybulkcards.com, a phone app and website for scanning, organizing, and searching Pokémon card collections, especially the thousands of bulk cards that my daughter and I have in our closet from playing.
